title: Two men killed by falling trees as Storm Boelo leaves 160,000 properties without power
description: An amber wind warning has now expired after severe weather sweeps across the UK.

title: Serbia's veteran ruler Vučić concedes election to student-led protest movement
description: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

title: Burnham open to 'honest discussion' on EU free movement
description: The PM says he wants a "factual" and "evidence-based debate" about returning to free movement between Britain and Europe.

title: Letter making claims about Meghan's father written by his first wife, BBC understands
description: Roslyn Loveless, who has since died, divorced Meghan's father in 1975. Meghan said she had been informed about the "disturbing allegations" in 2018.

title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
description: Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

title: Board of Deputies of British Jews declares Greens to be racist party
description: The Jewish body's vote comes in response to the Green Party passing a "Zionism is racism" policy motion.

title: End approaching for Carrick but Man Utd owners' problems far bigger
description: Manchester United's fans sang their support for Michael Carrick during the 3-0 home defeat by Bournemouth, but voiced their opposition to virtually everything else.

title: Couple were celebrating anniversary before Bahamas tragedy
description: Leanne Gregory, from Stapleford in Nottinghamshire, died trying to save her sons swept out to sea.

title: Long queues after power surge at Stansted Airport
description: A passenger says she was trapped in a corridor at the airport for 90 minutes.
